0022600042.text: The LA Clippers (2-8, 0-5 on the road, 2-3 at home) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (8-2, on a four-game winning streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup, the Clippers' 11th game of the season. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Cam Christie (ankle), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Thunder are missing Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Clippers trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 108-101 loss in Oklahoma City on October 25, and they lost all three meetings with Oklahoma City in 2025-26.
